notes: Every string is valid Unicode. Lone surrogates are excluded.
Boolean limits are excluded: the Rust limit is typed, so the boolean case has no Rust input.
Instants with a year below 1000 and non-ASCII digits in instants are excluded: strftime padding is platform-dependent, and the Rust clock refuses non-ASCII digits.
A case with d16_tightened true is accepted by a lenient UUID parser; the canonical pattern refuses it, so the Rust decode must refuse it too.
A lenient UUID parser converts the hex digits with int(hex, 16), which also accepts non-ASCII decimal digits (for example U+0661 and U+FF10). Those spellings are d16_tightened.
